title: The finite coset sum intertwines the G-actions
statement: Let k be a commutative ring, G a group, A and B k-linear G-representations in the same representation universe, and H ≤ G. Equip Q = G/H with a Fintype structure and write t_q = Quotient.out q. For every H-equivariant k-linear map F : Res_H B → Res_H A, every g ∈ G, and every x ∈ B, Σ_{q∈Q} ρ_A(t_q)F(ρ_B(t_q⁻¹)(ρ_B(g)x)) = ρ_A(g)(Σ_{q∈Q} ρ_A(t_q)F(ρ_B(t_q⁻¹)x)). No normality of H or finiteness of G, H, A, or B is required beyond the supplied finiteness of Q.
lean_statement: ∀ {k G : Type _} [CommRing k] [Group G] (A B : Rep k G) (H : Subgroup G) [Fintype (G ⧸ H)] (F : Quiver.Hom (Rep.res H.subtype B) (Rep.res H.subtype A)) (g : G) (x : B), (∑ q : G ⧸ H, A.ρ q.out (F.hom (B.ρ q.out⁻¹ (B.ρ g x)))) = A.ρ g (∑ q : G ⧸ H, A.ρ q.out (F.hom (B.ρ q.out⁻¹ x)))
